request.description: Request initializes the execution. It must be the first message of the stream.

writeData.description: WriteData writes data to the command's standard input.

ExecRequest.title: Exec Request
ExecRequest.description: ExecRequest is a client message of the Exec bidirectional stream. The first message of the stream must carry a `request`.

workspaceRef.description: WorkspaceRef is the reference of the Workspace in which the command is executed.

command.description: Command is the shell command to be executed.

workingDir.description: WorkingDir is the working directory of the command.

envVars.description: EnvVars is the list of the environment variables that are set for the command.

runAsRoot.description: RunAsRoot runs the command as `root` instead of as the Workspace User.

hasStdin.description: HasStdin means that the client streams stdin to the command via the subsequent writeData messages.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ExecRequest.title: Request
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ExecRequest.description: Request initializes the execution. It must be the first message that is sent by the client.

key.description: Key is the environment variable's name.

value.description: Value is the environment variable's value.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ExecRequest.title: Env Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ExecRequest.description: EnvVar is an environment variable that is set for the executed command.

data.description: Data is the raw data that is written to the command's standard input.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ExecRequest.title: Write Data
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ExecRequest.description: WriteData writes data to the command's standard input.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
